categories.main_business_segments: SMIC primarily operates in integrated circuit wafer manufacturing and testing, including silicon and compound semiconductor wafers. The company also provides related development, design, and technical services, photomask manufacturing, and sales of self-produced products. It offers 8-inch and 12-inch wafer foundry services and aims to build a platform-based ecosystem providing design services, IP support, and photomask manufacturing to support the integrated circuit industry chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: SMIC employs advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies with multiple technology platforms including 28nm ultra-low power, 40nm embedded memory automotive platform, 4X nm NOR Flash, 55nm high-voltage display driver automotive platform, and others. The company follows a structured R&D process from project selection to product launch, emphasizing technology innovation, process optimization, and platform development. Manufacturing involves small batch trial production, risk production, and mass production stages, with strict quality and process controls.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global integrated circuit design companies and IDM enterprises, with major customers in China, the US, and Eurasia. Its wafer foundry services cater to applications in smartphones, computers and tablets, consumer electronics, internet and wearable devices, industrial and automotive sectors. The top five customers accounted for 37.1% of revenue in 2023, indicating a moderately concentrated customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: SMIC's operations and major assets are primarily located in mainland China, with key manufacturing sites in Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Shenzhen, and other Chinese cities. It maintains marketing and service offices in the US, Europe, Japan, Taiwan, and Hong Kong to support global customers. The majority of revenue is generated from the China region (80.1%), followed by the US (16.4%) and Eurasia (3.5%).
categories.supply_chain_position: SMIC operates as a leading wafer foundry in the semiconductor supply chain, positioned upstream as a key manufacturer of integrated circuit wafers. It collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of raw materials, equipment, and software, and downstream customers including chip designers and packaging/testing companies. The company also promotes supply chain integration and ecosystem collaboration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-quality, differentiated technology platforms and capacity expansion, emphasizing technology leadership, cost control, and customer-centric service. R&D priorities include advancing mature and specialty process nodes, developing automotive and IoT platforms, and enhancing manufacturing capabilities. SMIC invests heavily in R&D with a dedicated team of over 2,300 personnel and maintains a robust patent portfolio to build technological barriers.
categories.revenue_model: SMIC generates revenue primarily through wafer foundry services, including manufacturing and testing of integrated circuit wafers. It also earns income from related services such as design support, IP licensing, and photomask manufacturing. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods or services, mainly through direct sales to customers. The company does not rely on subscription or advertising models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SMIC is ranked as the fourth largest pure-play wafer foundry globally and the leading foundry in mainland China. It competes with global industry leaders such as TSMC, Samsung, and GlobalFoundries. While it has a significant market share in China, it faces intense competition and technological gaps compared to top-tier international foundries. The company aims to strengthen its competitive position through technology innovation and capacity growth.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, SMIC reported revenue of RMB 45.25 billion, a decrease of 8.6% year-over-year, reflecting industry cyclicality and market demand softness. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 4.82 billion, down 60.3% from the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 338.5 billion with net assets of RMB 142.5 billion. The company operates with an average capacity utilization of 75% and monthly 8-inch equivalent wafer capacity of 806,000 pieces. Despite short-term challenges, SMIC maintains a stable financial structure and continues capital investment for capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SMIC emphasizes its comprehensive and integrated wafer foundry technology platforms, offering one-stop 8-inch and 12-inch wafer manufacturing and technical services. It differentiates through localized manufacturing capabilities in China, strong R&D and innovation, extensive patent portfolio, and a broad product platform covering logic, analog, memory, RF, and specialty processes. The company also provides integrated ecosystem services including design support and photomask manufacturing, aiming to reduce customer costs and time-to-market while ensuring supply chain stability.
